Meet Your Healer

Expert BKS Iyengar Yoga Therapist in Dehradun

Yogacharya Ajit Singh

Medical Yoga Therapist
BKS Iyengar Trained · 15+ Years Experience

In his early years of practice, Yogacharya Ajit Singh worked with a patient who had been told by two orthopaedic surgeons that spinal fusion surgery was his only option. The patient could not sit for more than ten minutes. After sixteen weeks of structured Iyengar therapy — using bolsters, wall ropes, and precise vertebral decompression sequences — he cancelled the surgery. That case changed everything. Trained in the BKS Iyengar tradition at RIMYI Pune, Ajit Singh has spent 15+ years building a clinical practice where conditions that conventional medicine could not resolve are met with precision, patience, and the right props. Over 1,200 patients later, the belief that founded this centre remains unchanged: the body does not need to be fixed — it needs to be understood.

  • Trained in BKS Iyengar Yoga Therapy
  • 15+ Years Clinical Experience
  • 1,200+ Patients Successfully Treated
  • Specialist in Spine and Joint Conditions

Got Questions?

BKS Iyengar Yoga Therapy — Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers before you book

What should I bring to my first session?
Comfortable clothing you can move in. No yoga experience needed — and no mat required. Just come as you are. We provide all props: belts, blocks, bolsters, and chairs.
Will it work for my specific condition?
In your free first consultation, Yogacharya Ajit Singh will assess your condition personally. If Iyengar therapy cannot help you, he will tell you honestly. We never take payment for a programme we cannot deliver results for.
What if I am in too much pain to do yoga?
Pain is exactly why you are here. BKS Iyengar developed this system for people in pain. Props and wall ropes mean you never strain. Many patients begin their first session unable to stand for 10 minutes — and leave standing straighter.
